answer: Atmospheric acoustic attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by linking agent identities to physical propagation baselines. Nodes authenticate by emitting a faint whisper of ultrasonic pulses across a spiral sensor array to measure drift from an ambient zephyr. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of maintaining distinct physical transceivers per identity. However, thermal turbulence can perturb acoustic paths, falsely rejecting honest agents.
